title: Fordham's Ghazali selection is about remembrance of death and the afterlife
summary: Fordham hosts an English selection of al-Ghazali on remembering death and the afterlife.
body: Fordham publishes a selection from al-Ghazali under the title The Remembrance of Death and the Afterlife. The page is an English excerpt of a Sufi and legal scholar's writing on death, not a creed agreed by every Muslim school. The wording on the page includes: "Sciences (Ihya `ulum al-din) as-Salaamu `alaykum, Al-Ghazali : The Remembrance of Death and the Afterlife (Kitab dhikr al-mawt wa-ma ba'dahu) ISBN: 0 946621 13 6 (Islamic Texts Society) Book XL of The Revival of the Religious Sciences (Ihya `ulum al-din) translated with an introduction and notes by T.J.Winter [Introduction by the modern fan of". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
